_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Ghana covering Akan goldfields, Ashanti Empire, slave castles, Gold Coast colony, Nkrumah pan-Africanism, coups, and Fourth Republic.

ethnic_groups.name: Akan
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest meta-group; includes Ashanti (Asante) 14.8%, Fante 9.9%, Akuapem, Akyem, Bono, Kwahu, Nzema; Twi language; matrilineal; gold trade heritage

ethnic_groups.name: Mole-Dagbani
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Ghana; Dagomba, Mamprusi, Nanumba, Mossi; Dagbani language; patrilineal; historic northern kingdoms

ethnic_groups.name: Ewe
ethnic_groups.notes: Volta Region; cross-border with Togo; Ewe language; historically Anlo kingdom; coastal fishing and trade

ethnic_groups.name: Ga-Dangme
ethnic_groups.notes: Greater Accra; Ga people in Accra, Dangme along coast; Homowo festival; historic Ga-Mashie state

ethnic_groups.name: Gurma (Guan)
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern and Brong-Ahafo; considered among earliest Akan-related settlers

ethnic_groups.name: Guan
ethnic_groups.notes: Scattered; Gonja, Nchumuru, Anum-Boso; diverse sub-groups

ethnic_groups.name: Grusi
ethnic_groups.notes: Upper West; Kasena, Sisala, Wala; related to Burkina groups

ethnic_groups.name: Mande
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Ghana; Wangara/Dyula traders; Islamic scholarship tradition

independence.notes: First sub-Saharan African nation to gain independence

current_leader.name: John Dramani Mahama
current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: NDC; returned to power after defeat in 2016; previously president 2012–2017; served as VP under Atta Mills

former_presidents.name: Kwame Nkrumah
former_presidents.notes: Pan-Africanist icon; first PM 1957–1960, President 1960–1966; OAU founder; overthrown by military coup

former_presidents.name: Jerry Rawlings
former_presidents.notes: Flight Lieutenant; 1979 and 1981 coups; PNDC rule; transitioned to multiparty democracy 1992; two elected terms; died 2020

former_presidents.name: John Kufuor
former_presidents.notes: NPP; first peaceful democratic transition; economic growth era

former_presidents.name: John Atta Mills
former_presidents.notes: NDC; died in office July 2012; first sitting president to die in office

former_presidents.name: Nana Akufo-Addo
former_presidents.notes: NPP; son of former president Edward Akufo-Addo; Free SHS policy; debt crisis

910.name: Prehistoric Ghana
910.description: Stone Age cultures; early settlement of forest and coastal zones; Kintampo culture.

sub_clusters.name: Kintampo Culture
sub_clusters.description: Neolithic Kintampo complex; earliest pottery and food production in the Ghana forest zone.

sub_clusters.name: Early Iron Age
sub_clusters.description: Transition to iron-working; expansion of agricultural communities.

920.name: Akan Goldfields and Early States
920.description: Akan gold-mining traditions; Bono state; Begho trading town; trans-Saharan gold trade links.

sub_clusters.name: Bono State (Bono-Manso)
sub_clusters.description: Earliest Akan state; gold trade with Djenné and trans-Saharan networks; Bono-Manso capital.

sub_clusters.name: Begho Trading Town
sub_clusters.description: Major trade entrepôt linking forest goldfields to savanna; Juula merchants.

sub_clusters.name: Dagbon and Northern States
sub_clusters.description: Dagomba, Mamprusi, Gonja kingdoms in the north; cavalry states; Yendi Dabari.

930.name: Ashanti Empire
930.description: Rise of the Ashanti Confederacy; Golden Stool; military expansion; British wars.

sub_clusters.name: Foundation of the Ashanti Union
sub_clusters.description: Osei Tutu I and Okomfo Anokye; Golden Stool legend; Kumasi capital; confederation of Akan states.

sub_clusters.name: Ashanti Imperial Expansion
sub_clusters.description: Ashanti conquers Denkyira, Akyem, Fante; controls trade routes to coast; gold and slave trade.

sub_clusters.name: Anglo-Ashanti Wars
sub_clusters.description: Five major wars between Ashanti and British; Battle of Amoaful 1874; sack of Kumasi.

930.name: European Forts and the Slave Trade
930.description: Portuguese Elmina Castle; Dutch, Danish, British forts; Gold Coast as major slave-exporting region.

sub_clusters.name: Elmina Castle and Portuguese Gold Coast
sub_clusters.description: São Jorge da Mina built 1482; first European structure in sub-Saharan Africa; gold then slave trade.

sub_clusters.name: Cape Coast Castle and British Slave Trade
sub_clusters.description: British headquarters; largest slave-holding dungeon; 'Door of No Return'; abolished 1807.

sub_clusters.name: Fante Confederacy
sub_clusters.description: Fante chiefs form confederation to resist Ashanti and negotiate with British; early African nationalism.

940.name: British Gold Coast Colony
940.description: Crown Colony; Ashanti annexed; cocoa economy; nationalism; Nkrumah and the CPP.

sub_clusters.name: Crown Colony Established
sub_clusters.description: Gold Coast Colony proclaimed 1874; Ashanti conquered and annexed 1896–1902; Yaa Asantewaa War.

sub_clusters.name: Cocoa Economy and Colonial Development
sub_clusters.description: Cocoa becomes Gold Coast's primary export; Tetteh Quarshie; African farmers drive industry.

sub_clusters.name: Gold Coast Nationalism
sub_clusters.description: UGCC; Nkrumah founds CPP 1949; 'Self-Government Now'; 1951 elections; march to independence.

950.name: Nkrumah and Pan-Africanism
950.description: First sub-Saharan African country to gain independence; Nkrumah's pan-African vision; one-party state.

sub_clusters.name: Independence of Ghana
sub_clusters.description: Independence 6 March 1957; first sub-Saharan African colony to achieve freedom; renamed Ghana.

sub_clusters.name: Nkrumah's Pan-African Vision
sub_clusters.description: All-African People's Conference 1958; OAU founding 1963; Akosombo Dam; Consciencism.

sub_clusters.name: One-Party State and 1966 Coup
sub_clusters.description: CPP single party; Preventive Detention Act; economic decline; NLC military coup February 1966.

950.name: Era of Military Coups
950.description: Alternating military and civilian governments; Rawlings AFRC and PNDC; economic crisis and recovery.

sub_clusters.name: NLC and Busia Period
sub_clusters.description: National Liberation Council; Busia elected 1969; Progress Party; Acheampong coup 1972.

sub_clusters.name: Rawlings AFRC and PNDC
sub_clusters.description: June 4 uprising 1979; Rawlings' PNDC coup 1981; ERP structural adjustment; transition.

960.name: Fourth Republic
960.description: 1992 constitution; democratic consolidation; NDC-NPP alternation; oil discovery; economic challenges.

sub_clusters.name: Democratic Transition
sub_clusters.description: 1992 constitution; Rawlings elected democratically; peaceful transfer to Kufuor 2001.

sub_clusters.name: Democratic Consolidation
sub_clusters.description: Two-party alternation; oil discovery at Jubilee Field 2007; Ghana as democratic model.

sub_clusters.name: Contemporary Challenges
sub_clusters.description: Akufo-Addo NPP; debt crisis; IMF programme 2023; cedi depreciation; Year of Return 2019.
